object.attr: derived: `ok` false would invite a retry that writes twice: a repeated `new_object` creates a second object. With `ok` true, MELLON-MCP-SRS-70 and MELLON-MCP-SRS-94 don't contradict (review Q3). Decided on 2026-11-10. Probably what 0.3.0 does; set Implemented once a test shows it.
object.description: If the commit for a `commit_message` fails after the call's write succeeded, the MCP server shall return `ok` true and no `commit`.
